name: Black Sea Dahu at Casa da Música
description: Catch the acclaimed Swiss indie-folk band Black Sea Dahu on their latest tour. Experience their haunting melodies and rich orchestration in the world-class setting of Casa da Música.
longDescription:
Black Sea Dahu, the Swiss indie-folk ensemble led by Janine Cathrein, performs at Casa da Música. The band is known for its intricate arrangements and melancholic soundscapes, which have garnered international recognition since their debut. Their music often features layered vocals, string sections, and a blend of acoustic and electric instrumentation, contributing to a distinctive sonic identity within the contemporary folk genre. This performance is part of their current tour, showcasing material from their recent releases alongside established works.

Attendees will experience an evening of live music in Sala 2 of Casa da Música, an intimate setting within the modern architectural landmark. The performance is expected to feature the band’s full instrumental lineup, presenting their compositions in a concert format. The atmosphere is typically focused, allowing the audience to engage with the nuanced sound production and lyrical content. The duration of the concert is standard for a touring musical act.

Tickets for this event are priced at €22.00. Casa da Música is located near the Carolina Michaelis metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F), approximately a 5-minute walk. Several bus lines also serve the area. Information regarding accessibility for visitors with mobility impairments is available directly from the venue.
